records.context: A decoy sits two or more edits from every barcode, so it misses the reads that land one edit from a guide, and with short prefixes the decoy FDR then runs below the barcode-shuffle call rate. Here the scale is raised until the shuffle call rate is at most :data:`SHUFFLE_FDR_RATIO` times the calibrated FDR on the tuning fields: :func:`tune_thresholds` chooses at the current scale; at the chosen setting the scale needed is the tuning fields' shuffle call rate over 1.5 times the scale-1 FDR (the upper end of its 95 % field-bootstrap interval with ``ci``); while that exceeds the current scale the scale becomes it and the tuner chooses again. The scale only rises, so the loop ends. Only decoy and shuffle calls are read, never a reference call set, and the report fields are not used.

records.translation: Tálbeita liggur tveimur eða fleiri breytingum frá hverju strikamerki, svo hún missir af lestrunum sem lenda einni breytingu frá leiðsögn, og með stuttum forskeytum fer tálbeitu-FDR þá undir kallatíðni strikamerkjauppstokkunar. Hér er kvarðinn hækkaður þar til kallatíðni uppstokkunar er í mesta lagi :data:`SHUFFLE_FDR_RATIO` sinnum kvarðaða FDR á sjónsviðum stillingarhlutans: :func:`tune_thresholds` velur við núverandi kvarða; við völdu stillinguna er kvarðinn sem þarf kallatíðni uppstokkunar á sjónsviðum stillingarhlutans deilt með 1.5 sinnum FDR við kvarða 1 (efri mörk 95 % bils þess úr sjónsviðs-bootstrap með ``ci``); á meðan hann er hærri en núverandi kvarði verður kvarðinn hann og stillirinn velur aftur. records.context: The far decoys of :func:`prefix_decoy_library` lie two or more edits from every prefix, so they never catch a read error that lands one edit from a guide. A near-miss decoy is one such neighbour: for each library prefix (decoys excluded), in key order, one generator (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) draws a cycle and a different base; the result is kept when it is one edit from that prefix and from no other key (prefix, far decoy or near-miss decoy already kept), until ``k`` are kept or ``8 * k`` draws are spent. Near-miss decoys join the whitelist as callable keys of gene :data:`NEARMISS_GENE` (level ``'nearmiss'``), so a read that matches one, exactly or as its single closest key, is a near-miss decoy call. Exact-only matching loses no real read to them; with one mismatch a read one edit from both a prefix and a near-miss decoy is ambiguous. They have no one-base extension.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix.prefix_nearmiss_decoys#1
records.source: The far decoys of :func:`prefix_decoy_library` lie two or more edits from every prefix, so they never catch a read error that lands one edit from a guide. A near-miss decoy is one such neighbour: for each library prefix (decoys excluded), in key order, one generator (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) draws a cycle and a different base; the result is kept when it is one edit from that prefix and from no other key (prefix, far decoy or near-miss decoy already kept), until ``k`` are kept or ``8 * k`` draws are spent. Near-miss decoys join the whitelist as callable keys of gene :data:`NEARMISS_GENE` (level ``'nearmiss'``), so a read that matches one, exactly or as its single closest key, is a near-miss decoy call. Exact-only matching loses no real read to them; with one mismatch a read one edit from both a prefix and a near-miss decoy is ambiguous. They have no one-base extension.
records.translation: Fjarlægu tálbeiturnar úr :func:`prefix_decoy_library` liggja tveimur eða fleiri breytingum frá hverju forskeyti, svo þær grípa aldrei lestrarvillu sem lendir einni breytingu frá leiðsögn. Nálægðartálbeita er einn slíkur nágranni: fyrir hvert forskeyti safnsins (að tálbeitum undanskildum), í röð lyklanna, dregur einn rafall (``numpy.random.default_rng(seed)``) lotu og annan basa; niðurstaðan er geymd þegar hún er einni breytingu frá því forskeyti og frá engum öðrum lykli (forskeyti, fjarlægri tálbeitu eða nálægðartálbeitu sem þegar hefur verið geymd), þar til ``k`` hafa verið geymdar eða ``8 * k`` útdrættir hafa verið notaðir. Nálægðartálbeitur bætast við hvíta listann sem kallanlegir lyklar gensins :data:`NEARMISS_GENE` (stig ``'nearmiss'``), þannig að lestur sem passar við eina þeirra, nákvæmlega eða sem eini næsti lykill hans, er nálægðartálbeitukall. Samsvörun eingöngu við nákvæm gildi tapar engum raunverulegum lestri til þeirra; með einu misræmi er lestur sem er einni breytingu frá bæði forskeyti og nálægðartálbeitu tvíræður. Þær hafa enga eins-basa framlengingu.
